source.title: Westminster Leningrad Codex via Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible
source.attribution: Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible available at https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb
source.provenance: Extracted from OSHB wlc/Dan.xml: A-coded words only, slash morphology boundaries joined; cantillation and maqaf preserved. In Daniel 2:4 the qere word is selected, not combined with the ketiv. No independent scholarly proofreading.
source.licenseNote: WLC base text public domain; OSHB lemma/morphology CC BY 4.0; lexical transcription CC BY 4.0.
source.modifications: Reading-path extraction; morpheme separators removed; source word order and marks preserved.

review.reviewedBy: Codex source-extraction check (automated, not a scholarly language review)
review.notes: Wording compared to A-coded OSHB source tokens, excluding ketiv in favor of qere. Linguistic analysis comes from OSHB; no claim of independent expert review.

verification.against: OSHB wlc/Dan.xml (qere reading path, A-coded tokens)
verification.by: Codex extraction compared to source word and seg values

sentences.text: עָנֵ֤ה דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ וְאָמַ֔ר לֶהֱוֵ֨א שְׁמֵ֤הּ דִּֽי־אֱלָהָא֙ מְבָרַ֔ךְ מִן־עָלְמָ֖א וְעַ֣ד־עָלְמָ֑א דִּ֧י חָכְמְתָ֛א וּגְבוּרְתָ֖א דִּ֥י לֵֽהּ־הִֽיא׃
